title: Therapeutic potential of umbilical cord-derived MSCs in arthritis: Insights from preclinical and clinical studies

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Therapeutic potential of umbilical cord-derived MSCs in arthritis: Insights from preclinical and clinical studies》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Among different types of arthritis, osteoarthritis (OA) and rheumatoid arthritis (RA) remain the most common and primary cause of pain and disability worldwide, characterized by progressive joint degeneration and persistent inflammation.
